domain-information: A Designer sketches a new clothing concept to explore ideas for the next collection.
A Designer selects fabrics for the sample production of a concept.
A Production Manager reviews the design to estimate materials and manufacturing effort.
A Production Manager approves a sample run so production can start.
A Production Manager adds a piece to the collection after its concept has been approved.
A Manufacturing Officer sends an order for production of the new collection to a manufacturer.
A Manufacturing Officer receives an order from a retail buyer.
A Marketing Manager creates a campaign outline to introduce the upcoming collection.
A Marketing Manager requests final product media from the designer to prepare promotional content.
A Retail Buyer reviews the collection to decide which items to stock in stores.
A Retail Buyer places an order for selected pieces to meet expected customer demand.
A Retail Buyer confirms delivery dates to ensure the products arrive in time for launch.
A Designer reviews feedback from the buyer to adjust future design choices.

domain objects.name: Designer
domain objects.description: Person creating clothing concepts and related materials.

domain objects.name: Clothing Concept
domain objects.description: Initial design idea for a potential garment.

domain objects.name: Sample Production
domain objects.description: Small production run of a concept using selected fabrics.

domain objects.name: Fabric
domain objects.description: Material chosen for producing sample pieces.

domain objects.name: Collection
domain objects.description: Set of finalized pieces prepared for a season or release.

domain objects.name: Piece
domain objects.description: Individual garment derived from a clothing concept.

domain objects.name: Campaign Outline
domain objects.description: Initial structure of the marketing campaign for a collection.

domain objects.name: Production Manager
domain objects.description: Person estimating and approving production-related work.

domain objects.name: Effort Estimate
domain objects.description: Assessment of materials and work needed for a concept.

domain objects.name: Marketing Manager
domain objects.description: Person planning and coordinating marketing activities.

domain objects.name: Final Product Media
domain objects.description: Images or media files used for promotional content.

domain objects.name: Retail Buyer
domain objects.description: Person selecting and ordering pieces for retail stores.

domain objects.name: Retail Order
domain objects.description: Order placed by a retail buyer for specific pieces with delivery dates.

domain objects.name: Delivery Date
domain objects.description: Confirmed date for delivering ordered pieces.

domain objects.name: Feedback
domain objects.description: Input from the retail buyer regarding the pieces or collection.

domain objects.name: Manufacturing Officer
domain objects.description: Person coordinating production and handling manufacturing requests.

domain objects.name: Production Order
domain objects.description: Instruction to manufacture items in a collection.

domain objects.name: Manufacturer
domain objects.description: Entity responsible for producing physical garments.

associations.description: Production Manager reviews the Clothing Concept.
Production Manager approves the Sample Production.
Production Manager produces the Effort Estimate.
Production Manager adds a Piece to the Collection.
Marketing Manager creates the Campaign Outline.
Marketing Manager requests Final Product Media.
Designer provides the Final Product Media.
Manufacturing Officer issues the Production Order.
Production Order is sent to the Manufacturer.
Retail Buyer creates the Retail Order.
Manufacturing Officer receives the Retail Order.
Retail Order leads to generated Feedback.
